MEET THE ARTIST / 이세계

ESEGYE

ESEGYE is a Korean band whose name points to another world. They began releasing music in 2020, writing about the deep feelings people often keep to themselves.

“RomanceYouthLove” appeared on ESEGYE’s debut double single in June 2020. The band’s own recording from its first BLIND concert at Veloso Hongdae places this early song in front of an audience.
